goal: Wayfarer cockpit v3 (author 8. 10. 2026, approved plan ArtSource/Ships/Wayfarer/Concept/Cockpit/cockpit_layout_v3_proposal.png): sticks on the seat arms, thin wall consoles running into the dash wings, aisles round the seat, tread plates with light lines; the cockpit's surfaces in one glossy light paint (the author loves the white glossy column under the holo radar), graphite insets, cool light lines, a 3D holo radar. The author wants MUCH more detail everywhere, SC level. Find the highest-impact detail gaps per surface (dash, wall consoles, seat arms, floor, walls, canopy frame) with concrete measurable fixes. Round 4 (cockpit v4) changes: side consoles rebuilt after the approved concept B - one lofted shape from the wall lining up into the dash wing, satin white paint, one graphite field on the sloped top (SYS rockers, large red EMER key under cover, power bars, caution lamp), three lit windows in the inner face, a recessed kick with a band of light, a light line on the inner top edge, spots onto the faces; MFD v5 on all pages (speed and G in radar-style rings, white type, underlined tabs, clean tables, thin thrust lines) and holo field + projector beam; trim hierarchy (walls 1.2 m tile at 50 %, consoles 0.45 m); seat arm supports as swept struts into flanges (no hanging blocks); a graphite anti-slip floor field behind the seat; canopy frame chamfer 16 mm. Not yet: the seat shell itself, larger labels.
style: Úroveň SC, ne přesná kopie. Halcyon: bílý lesklý lak, grafitové vložky, studené světelné linky, oranžové akcenty jen na madlech a logu. Díly jsou nové z výroby – žádné opotřebení ani špína.
notes: Díly jsou nové z výroby záměrně: nežádej opotřebení, škrábance ani špínu.
Reference SC jsou styl a úroveň detailu, ne rozměry.
Hodnoť hlavně hustotu a kvalitu detailu (vrstvení, panely, spáry, šrouby, štítky, světla) – autor chce víc detailu všude.
